page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 34 at left. Main text in a single column in the centre-right. Faint show-through in the left margin (not transcribed). Catchword-like "SECT." at bottom right, treated as a catchword.

main_text.p: quicquid Apostoli, Concilia, sanctique nascentis Ecclesiæ patres nobis credendum proposuerint, parùm protectò iuuerit, neque nos vnâ conuenas facere potuerit, nisi hodierno etiam Pontificulo fidem nostram mancupio dederimus: Istâc vero lege vt nos pacem mauelimus? Quiduis ilicet sperare aufit, qui hoc autumet; Neq; illi nos fastidiosiùs ex Ecclesiæ suæ gremio eiecerint, qui stramineos hosce articulos vsq; conspuimus; quàm nos illos, Ecclesiæ Dei hæc talia tánto molimine plusquàm tyrannicè obtrudentes, fidenter damnamus, & execramur.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page in the left margin and faint marginal traces; not transcribed. Some words in the margin are unreadable. Printed text in the column is transcribed as printed, including the long s rendered as plain s.
